problem: A merged obligation could fail terminal closure when its exact merge Brain foundation run was cancelled by newer main, while terminalizer could emit LIVE_BEWEZEN with merged_lineage_verified=false.
root_cause: Cancelled superseded Brain evidence was treated as a genuine gate failure.
GITHUB_ENV does not propagate to processes inside the same shell step, so LINEAGE_MODE became unknown.
Terminalizer did not reject a false merged_lineage_verified boolean.
fix: Allow descendant Brain proof only for cancelled/skipped exact runs after merge containment in current main.
Keep genuine exact Brain failures fail-closed.
Pass LINEAGE_MODE directly into the same Node invocation.
Reject LIVE evidence when merged lineage verification is false.
Scope terminalizer workflow changes to automation delivery.
prevention: Supersession may replace only reversible cancelled/skipped evidence, never genuine failing quality evidence.
Terminal status requires every mandatory evidence boolean true.
Same-step shell state is passed directly rather than via GITHUB_ENV.
